author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Realms Pro Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creation-based adventure game developed by Mojang. Players can now come together in 50-player private servers to assemble towns, mini-games, and more. Realms Pro for Minecraft is available now.
title: Minecraft - Official Realms Pro Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Accolades Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2, a retro arcade action first-person shooter developed by Auroch Digital. Players can get a look at the critical reception of the latest shooter, full of enemies to take on and carnage to dish out in the process. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Enjoy the launch trailer for Stormforge, which might most generously be described as a bit of Valheim and a bit of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. Stormforge is a fantasy open-world survival crafting game for up to eight players where you'll battle (and harness) sentient magical storms. Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826790/Stormforge/
title: Stormforge: Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for Casualties: Unknown, a 2D survival horror exploration game developed by Orsoniks. Players will traverse the deep and winding caves of a foreign planet to secure lost cargo. Manage injuries, overcome challenges, and survive at all costs in Casualties: Unknown, available now on PC (Steam).
title: Casualties: Unknown - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the ‘Dust & Distance’ Trailer for The Legend of California, an upcoming open-world action survival shooter developed by Kintsugiyama. Players can get a look at the diverse biomes and environments to explore across the mythical island during the Gold Rush era in California. The Legend of California is coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: The Legend of California - Official ‘Dust & Distance’ Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Hozy is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S. It is also available on PC and Mac. Check out the Hozy console launch trailer for this cozy home renovation game. Hozy on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S features 9 unique levels, with the bonus Game Plus and Sandbox modes.
title: Hozy - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Teaser Trailer for Beholder 4, a simulation strategy game developed by Paintbucket Games. Players will embody a double life as an official and an underground agent at the same time. Keep secrets close, spy on the public, and decide the fate of others in a sprawling totalitarian State. Beholder 4 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Beholder 4 - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at the colorful world, characters, and gameplay from Wish Upon a Llama in this trailer for the upcoming cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers. As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits! Wish Upon a Llama will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PlayStation 4 (PS4).
title: Wish Upon a Llama - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
K-pop Rising - Dream to Shine is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam). Check out the K-pop Rising - Dream to Shine launch trailer for this game, which blends lifestyle simulation, music, and rhythm-based gameplay.

In K-pop Rising - Dream to Shine, you can achieve your lifelong dream: becoming the next big K-Pop star. Customize your character and your band, master songs and dance routines, and grow your fan base as you climb to the very top of the K-Pop world.
title: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Ranchonauts, an upcoming slapstick space western co-op about herding alien sheep, where chaos is all part of the job description. In Ranchonauts, you're space explorers stranded on an alien world with your ship badly damaged, and you'll need money to pay off the repairs - lots of it. Wrangle your flock from one town to another, keeping your herd, your horse, and yourself in one piece. Sound easy? You wish! Ranchonauts will be available on PC (Steam).
title: Ranchonauts - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Version 1.0 of Hypnos is available now on Steam and GOG. Watch the Hypnos version 1.0 launch trailer for this first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a Lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Embrace your destiny.
title: Hypnos - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Neurospasm is available now on PC. Step injto the strange world of Neurospasm in this launch trailer for this first-person roguelike horde shooter game. In Neurospasm, hook your brain into your computer, dive into a game inside a game, unbox and stack unique items, use up to 6 weapons at once, kill weird fleshy enemies, and uncover why nothing here makes any sense.
title: Neurospasm - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Havkerman-X is available now on PC. Check out the Havkerman-X launch trailer to see brutal gameplay from this open-world, post-apocalyptic, first-person shooter, immersive Sim. Havkerman-X features high-risk, high-reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.
title: Havkerman-X - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Season 5 Casino Heist Event Trailer for Battlefield 6, the hit first-person action shooter developed by EA, DICE, and Battlefield Studios. Players will take the fight to Las Vegas in the Casino Heist Event as they take on the new European Casino map. Wield new weapons such as the NSW4 carbine, ADS-17 6GHz Signal Jammer, and M142 MRAS, with new event-exclusive rewards to attain. The Season 5 Casino Heist Event kicks off on November 10 on Battlefield 6 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and EA App).
title: Battlefield 6 - Official Season 5 Casino Heist Event Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy, a narrative-driven adventure RPG developed by Owlcat Games. Players will assert the will of the God-Emperor through tactical combat, difficult decisions, and leading investigations to uncover a grand conspiracy in the process. Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy is launching on January 28 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Season 2 Gameplay Update Overview for Mistfall Hunter, a dark fantasy extraction action RPG developed by Bellring Games. Players will get the rundown on what awaits in Season 2, with the Wildfire Forbidden Zone opening up to those who dare to take on the challenges that lie ahead. Wield the new Javelin weapon archetype, new server improvements, and more. Season 2 for Mistfall Hunter launches on November 11 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Season 2 Gameplay Update Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 'A Love Letter to Gears' 20th Anniversary Trailer for Gears of War: E-Day, the latest addition to the third-person action shooter developed by The Coalition. Players can take a trip down memory lane to see the 20-year journey of the Gears of War franchise, from the original Gears of War in 2006 to the latest adventure in Gears of War: E-Day. Gears of War: E-Day is available now for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Official 'A Love Letter to Gears' 20th Anniversary Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Embers' Dawnbreaker Closed Beta Release Date Trailer for Sea of Remnants, an upcoming action-adventure pirate game developed by Joker Studio. Players will soon be able to take to the high seas to face lethal monsters, assemble a fleet, and live out the pirate's life across Orbtopia and beyond. Get a glimpse of the story in the upcoming Dawnbreaker Closed Beta for Sea of Remnants, launching on December 3 for PC.
title: Sea of Remnants - Official 'Embers' Dawnbreaker Closed Beta Release Date Trailer
